title: Jubilant Basil Spanish Fettuccine Pa Amb Tomaquet
description: A simple yet flavorful Spanish dish featuring fettuccine, ferment-jang, and the tangy taste of tomato, all wrapped in a lotus leaf. This is a low-calorie-friendly weeknight option that is sure to satisfy your appetite.
instructions: Cook the fettuccine according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the red onion to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes until translucent.
Add the ferment-jang, tomato, and red pepper flakes to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes until the tomato starts to break down.
Add the cooked fettuccine to the skillet and toss with the tomato mixture until well combined.
To assemble the pa amb tomaquet, place a portion of the fettuccine mixture onto the center of a lotus leaf, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Add a few leaves of fresh basil on top of the fettuccine.
Fold the bottom edge of the leaf up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
